summary: Frontend-only regression on Dashboard sort headers, reference_number display in Contract ID column, and Submit form ordering. All 3 targeted fixes verified working. Auto-fill regression also verified.
verified_scenarios: Login as bu@bsimaslahat.co.id (Demo@2026) succeeded; redirected to Dashboard.
All 13 rows in Contract ID column display reference_number in slash format (e.g., '03/001/PKS/BSI MASLAHAT/2026', '04/PKS-2026/BSI MASLAHAT', ...). No 'PKS-2026-XXXXXX' auto-id shown.
sort-contract-id present, clickable; toggling asc<->desc reorders rows (verified opposite arrays).
sort-effective present, clickable; toggling changes row order.
sort-expiry present, clickable; toggling changes row order.
Sort arrow indicators (ArrowUp/ArrowDown) appear on active header only (SortHeader component uses active state).

/submit form heading order verified: ['Langkah 1 — Unggah Draft PKS (.docx)', 'Langkah 2 — Informasi Mitra', 'Langkah 3 — Detail Kerja Sama']. Dropzone precedes Informasi Mitra in DOM (compareDocumentPosition = FOLLOWING).
Uploading /app/tmp/pks.docx via dropzone auto-filled reference_number='03/xxx/PKS/BSI MASLAHAT', partner_name='NAMA LEMBAGA', title='PERJANJIAN YANG DISEPAKATI' with 3 AUTO badges rendered.
Filter by Status dropdown lists 9 options (All, Drafting, Submitted for Review, Under Legal Review, Revision Required, Legal Approved, Signed & Active, Expiring Soon, Expired).
critical_code_review_comments: SubmitContract.js contains a leftover hidden legacy card (style display:none) with data-testid='dropzone-legacy' (lines 288-298). Non-blocking, but should be removed to keep DOM clean.

Client-side lexicographic sort on Contract ID gives correct human-perceived order for the current 2-digit prefixed refs, but if a ref like '9/...' (single digit) or non-YYYY format appears, ordering may look off. Consider natural sort or numeric prefix parsing later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard sort headers (sort-contract-id/effective/expiry), reference_number column display, and Submit form re-ordering are all confirmed. Auto-fill via .docx still works. No open bugs from this iteration.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — all three reported bugs have been fixed and verified.
